Although regular toilet paper gets the job done, it’s not the best way to feel your best or cleanest throughout the day. And really, don’t you deserve better than just the bare minimum of cleanliness? Enter DUDE Wipes, flushable wet wipes that are hypoallergenic, as they helps you feel pristine and luxurious.

And right now, for Prime Big Deal Days, you can get select packs for up to 47% off list prices. It’s a great way to save big on your own personal hygiene with prices under $10.

With fun scents and sensations available, like Mint Chill, Shea BUTTer and others, DUDE Wipes are a life-changing way to clean up after you use the bathroom, especially if you have sensitive skin. Instead of feeling harsh toilet paper (no matter how “soft” it claims to be), these flushable wet wipes, which feature vitamin E and aloe, actually feel refreshing and ready to take on the day.

These wet wipes are great for day-to-day use, especially if you’re attending a music festival, concert or just traveling when toilet paper isn’t readily available or up to good hygiene standards. DUDE Wipes even come in very convenient travel packs, so you can take two or three with you when nature calls.
